text: {"lessons":["A falling account value is painful, but I should review each holding on its merits rather than avoid selling just to avoid admitting a mistake.","Recent price moves are random and do not predict what comes next, so I should not react to short-term losses as if they forecast more losses.","I should check that my holdings still fit my risk and diversification goals, and make deliberate changes when they do not rather than defaulting to inaction."]}
